issue.title: global-buffer-overflow PyUnicode_GET_LENGTH cpython/unicodeobject.h

labels.name: type-crash
labels.description: A hard crash of the interpreter, possibly with a core dump

issue.body:
# Crash report

### What happened?

```python
import ast
import unittest
class ASTConstructorTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_incomplete_field_types(self):
        class MoreFieldsThanTypes(ast.AST):
            _fields = (None, 'b')
            _field_types = {'a': int | None}
        with self.assertWarnsRegex(DeprecationWarning, "Field 'b' is missing from MoreFieldsThanTypes\\._field_types"):
            obj = MoreFieldsThanTypes()
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
